dcterms:description: A benchmark dataset for detecting hate speech on Twitter, specifically focusing on two targets: immigrants and women. The dataset is multilingual, but the authors used only the English subset for evaluation, which includes 9000 training, 1000 validation, and 2971 test annotated tweets.
dcterms:title: HatEval-2019 Dataset
